n309d6a55f2.headline: Oil above $100/barrel to stay as market struggles to replace Russian barrels: Reuters poll
n309d6a55f2.summary: A Reuters poll of 40 economists and analysts forecast Brent crude would average $103.07 a barrel this year, up from the previous poll. Respondents expect the market to struggle to wean itself off Russian oil.
n309d6a55f2.why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, and its price feeds into fuel, transport and input costs across the economy. Forecast polls shape expectations for energy producers and consumers.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: The poll forecasts Brent averaging above $100 a barrel, reflecting expected tight supply as Russian barrels are replaced.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7c3ea904e2.headline: Ukraine invasion: Stop all trade with Russia - Zelensky tells Dutch parliament
n7c3ea904e2.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky asked the Dutch parliament on Thursday for weapons, reconstruction aid and a halt to all business with Russia.
n7c3ea904e2.why: Sanctions and trade restrictions on Russia affect European companies with Russian exposure and global commodity flows.

ncdcb025a9d.headline: OPEC Ditches IEA Data Amid Rift
ncdcb025a9d.summary: OPEC is dropping International Energy Agency data amid a rift between the two bodies, and may make a formal ruling on the matter when ministers gather on Thursday.
ncdcb025a9d.why: OPEC and the IEA publish the oil market data that investors use to assess global supply, demand and inventories, so disputes over data affect how crude forecasts are read.

n8917348586.headline: Fuel prices go up from today while VAT zero rated on cooking gas
n8917348586.summary: The Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission set new fuel and gas prices, effective from today. Cooking gas will be zero-rated for VAT and a fuel levy is being removed.
n8917348586.why: Fuel and cooking gas prices feed into household costs and transport and logistics expenses across Fiji's economy.

n3479407652.headline: H&M sees boosted sales but Russian closures start to weigh
n3479407652.summary: H&M said its first-quarter revenue increased, but the closure of its Russian stores has started to affect results. The company reported the update from Stockholm.
n3479407652.why: H&M is a large Swedish fashion retailer with a global store network, so its sales trends signal demand in apparel retail.

n3f1d11b4ea.headline: FLC Group has new chairman after Quyet’s arrest
n3f1d11b4ea.summary: Property developer FLC Group said on March 31 that Dang Tat Thang will chair the group and Bamboo Airways until shareholders decide otherwise. The change follows Quyet's arrest.
n3f1d11b4ea.why: FLC Group is a Vietnamese property developer with an airline unit, Bamboo Airways, so leadership changes affect governance and its listed and affiliated businesses.

na576214968.headline: Protests planned over cost-of-living crisis and P&O sackings
na576214968.summary: A series of demonstrations is planned across the UK over the cost-of-living crisis and P&O sackings. Protests will include a rally outside Downing Street.
na576214968.why: Cost-of-living pressures and labour disputes affect consumer spending, wage negotiations and corporate restructuring costs across the UK economy.

n9a885f210b.headline: ZENVIA announces Tencent reaches 10% stake in Class A shares
n9a885f210b.summary: Zenvia announced that Tencent has reached a 10% stake in its Class A shares. The company describes itself as a leading cloud-based CX communications platform in Latin America.
n9a885f210b.why: Zenvia is a Nasdaq-listed Brazilian software company, and a large strategic stake by Tencent can signal investor interest and affect the shareholder register.

ne1c88293c7.headline: Sanichi Technology founder buys 64.97pc stake in Computer Forms Malaysia for RM79.9m
ne1c88293c7.summary: Sanichi Technology founder and managing director Pang Chow Huat has acquired a 64.97% stake in Computer Forms (Malaysia) for RM79.9 million, Malay Mail reports.
ne1c88293c7.why: Controlling-stake transactions in Malaysian listed companies can shift ownership and governance at smaller-cap firms.

ndd23820ab1.headline: Weibo Announces US$500 Million Share Repurchase Program
ndd23820ab1.summary: Chinese social media platform Weibo announced a US$500 million share repurchase program. The company is listed on Nasdaq and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
ndd23820ab1.why: Share buybacks return capital to shareholders and can support a stock's share price, and they signal management's view of the company's value.

n821139920c.headline: ‘Submit your meter readings today to pay the current rate on  gas and electricity used so far’, says expert
n821139920c.summary: An expert urges customers to submit meter readings now so they pay current rates for gas and electricity used so far. Failing to do so could mean higher rates.
n821139920c.why: Energy tariffs and billing accuracy affect household energy costs and the finances of UK utility suppliers.

ne82cc27295.headline: Concerned China asks all parties in Pakistan to stay united as Prime Minister Imran Khan Govt set to fall - Times of India
ne82cc27295.summary: China, Pakistan's ally, reacted guardedly on Thursday to the potential defeat of Prime Minister Imran Khan's government in parliament. Beijing asked all parties in Pakistan to stay united.
ne82cc27295.why: Pakistan's political stability affects its economy, its external financing and China-backed infrastructure projects.

n304642bc59.headline: Food safety watchdog takes next step in regulating CBD market
n304642bc59.summary: The Food Standards Agency is taking the next step in regulating the CBD market, as no CBD food products have yet been authorised for sale in the UK.
n304642bc59.why: Regulatory clearance determines whether CBD food and drink products can be legally sold, shaping the size of a growing consumer market.

na947774b57.headline: Tech group wants new visa for skilled workers to enter country without a job offer
na947774b57.summary: A group representing 150 of Canada's fastest-growing technology companies wants the federal government to pilot a new visa. The visa would let skilled workers enter the country without a job offer.
na947774b57.why: Immigration policy affects the labour supply for technology companies, and skilled-worker shortages can constrain growth in the sector.

ncabdad46dd.headline: President Erdoğan's Minimum Wage Statement: The Time Is December
ncabdad46dd.summary: President Erdoğan stated that the minimum wage commission meets annually and the decision on minimum wage will be made in December.
ncabdad46dd.why: Minimum wage decisions impact labor costs, consumer spending, and inflation in Turkey's economy.

n8974a51340.summary: Argentina's latest INDEC data showed a general inflation rate of 4.7%, with food prices being particularly alarming compared to previous presidencies.
n8974a51340.why: Inflation data is critical for understanding Argentina's economic stability and consumer purchasing power. High food inflation impacts cost of living and monetary policy decisions.

nda04757253.summary: Due to sanctions and currency market issues, Russian transport and logistics companies expect a 32% increase in road transport costs by year-end.
nda04757253.why: Rising logistics costs can increase inflationary pressures and disrupt supply chains in Russia, affecting businesses and consumers.

n3b5786de3d.summary: Spain's total public debt reached 1.42 trillion euros in 2021, falling to 118.4% of GDP and improving the government's fiscal target.
n3b5786de3d.why: Public debt levels are key indicators of fiscal health and influence sovereign credit ratings and borrowing costs in Spain.

ncac62579cb.headline: CABS Surplus Doubles As Lending Rebounds
ncac62579cb.summary: Corporate India's Q3FY22 margins declined due to rising commodity prices, according to HDFC Securities.
ncac62579cb.why: Margins of Indian companies are sensitive to input costs; higher commodity prices can reduce profitability and investment capacity.

nd285089f78.headline: Tunisian President dissolves parliament, threatens to prosecute MPs who voted to curb his powers
nd285089f78.summary: President Kais Saied dissolves Tunisia's parliament amid political unrest, threatening legal action against MPs who oppose him.
nd285089f78.why: Political instability can impact economic reforms, foreign investment, and regional stability in Tunisia.

n6991704821.headline: Central Bank of Armenia: exchange rates and prices of precious metals - 31-03-22
n6991704821.summary: The Central Bank of Armenia reports a 1.86 dram decrease in USD exchange rate to 485.91 drams and updates on precious metals prices.
n6991704821.why: Currency and gold prices influence inflation, monetary policy, and investor sentiment in Armenia.

nba692316f3.headline: SMC banking arm makes stock market debut
nba692316f3.summary: Bank of Commerce, part of San Miguel Corp., made its stock market debut, marking the first bank listing in nine years.
nba692316f3.why: This listing reflects banking sector activity and investor confidence in Philippine financial markets.

n55729d96fe.headline: Plenty of fish but no catch as Sri Lanka economic crisis bites
n55729d96fe.summary: Worsening economic conditions in Sri Lanka have led to fishermen being unable to operate due to lack of fuel, impacting local fish supply.
n55729d96fe.why: Economic crises reduce production capacity in key sectors, affecting local food supply and prices, with broader economic implications.

nbeea7ceb5a.headline: Indonesia Energy Is a High-Risk Gamble on Higher Oil Prices
nbeea7ceb5a.summary: Indonesia's INDO stock is considered more speculative amid booming oil prices, reflecting increased trader interest in the sector.
nbeea7ceb5a.why: Higher oil prices can boost Indonesia's energy exports and revenues, but also increase economic volatility.

n1398c49b10.headline: Visco: "The conflict in Ukraine is causing deep social and economic wounds"
n1398c49b10.summary: Ignazio Visco said serious geopolitical tensions threaten peace and that the conflict in Ukraine is causing deep social and economic wounds.
n1398c49b10.why: Comments from Italy's central bank governor shape views on the economic outlook, inflation and energy costs in Italy.

n4d3293d83d.why: Vaca Muerta is a major shale oil and gas formation in Argentina, and pipelines link production to export and domestic markets. Pipeline investment affects energy export revenues.
